test_title: PYST 139: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 30 Jan, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, FLAME is written as 'LPGQK', and BURNT is written as 'HYXRZ'. How will 'FRIED' be written in the same code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : Alternately (6) and then (4) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series.

So, 

 
• FLAME is written as 'LPGQK'

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5cff850da6b0f6453015bf3737200508f3f9bfa87f9c263fd6ae7d6a62e31e51.png] 

​And,

 
• BURNT is written as 'HYXRZ'

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4ed0ae6f6596ccdb235ef0fd4577b52168928e7a004743e44679bb573eebb484.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• 'FRIED' is written as:

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a47358de9d4fd435925f8cac91edef8cfbaa0fcd801290ca29ed555ede681f19.png] 

​Hence, "LVOIJ" is the correct answer.
